## Instructions

1. Mix rice, milk, sugar and salt in a buttered dish.
2. Bake at 300°F for 2 hours, stirring every half hour.
3. Add raisins and vanilla for the last half hour.
4. Sprinkle with nutmeg.

## Notes

From the church bazaar table.
